name: git-sweep-pro
description: Delete the local Git branches whose work is already merged or pushed, and their worktrees, from VS Code or the gsp command line, for you and your coding agents. Read-only plans, protected branches, undo.

enumDescriptions: Open Sweep Stale Branches as a preview: nothing can be deleted from it.
Offer the branches proven merged or pushed, all selected.
Also offer the branches that need a forced delete, such as commits found nowhere else. They are never selected for you.
gitSweepPro.defaultMode.description: How Sweep Stale Branches opens. Branches that need a forced delete can also be shown from the picker's title bar.

gitSweepPro.protectedBranches.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for branches that must never be deleted (e.g. `main`, `develop`, `release/*`). `*` matches any characters and `?` matches a single character.

gitSweepPro.autoFetchPrune.description: Read the remote before planning, and fetch with prune before deleting. Turn off to work from the remote-tracking branches already fetched.

gitSweepPro.confirmBeforeDelete.description: Ask before deleting the branches you picked. Forced deletes and deletions on the remote are always confirmed.

gitSweepPro.github.markdownDescription: Ask GitHub which pull requests are merged or open, through the GitHub CLI (`gh`) when it is signed in. Turn off to rely on Git alone (`--no-github`).

gitSweepPro.cleanRemoteBranches.markdownDescription: Also offer the merged branches on the remote (`origin`, or the only remote) in Sweep Stale Branches. Deleting them is confirmed separately, and they are deleted for everyone who uses that remote.

gitSweepPro.includeMergedBranches.markdownDescription: Also offer local branches whose work is already in the remote default branch (merged, rebase-merged or squash-merged) even though their upstream is not gone — e.g. branches that were never pushed or whose remote branch was kept. They are listed but never pre-selected.
gitSweepPro.includeMergedBranches.markdownDeprecationMessage: Merged branches are always offered now, and pre-selected when their work is proven merged. This setting does nothing.
gitSweepPro.includeMergedBranches.deprecationMessage: Merged branches are always offered now. This setting does nothing.

gitSweepPro.cli.addToTerminalPath.markdownDescription: Make the bundled `gsp` command line (also usable as `git-sweep-pro` and `git sweep-pro`) available in VS Code's integrated terminals. New terminals pick up changes.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run compile && vscode-test --label e2e --label e2e-mr
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run build && npm run compile && vscode-test --label e2e --label e2e-mr --coverage --coverage-output=coverage/e2e --coverage-reporter=text-summary --coverage-reporter=json-summary --coverage-reporter=lcov
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:check
